scenario: 40x20 canvas at (0,0) with CSS size, 2D context via rv_canvas_get_context, fillStyle #ff0000, fillRect(0,0,20,20); temporary diagnostic ranvier_canvas_debug (not committed) reads the context buffer

reading.hostPaint(5,5): [255,255,255,255] white page: canvas bitmap not painted

cause: HTMLCanvasElement::createElementRenderer and isReplaced return a RenderHTMLCanvas only when frame->script().canExecuteScripts(); the host sets setScriptEnabled(false), so a canvas renders its fallback content (RenderBlockFlow) and never paints its bitmap (spec: scripting disabled -> fallback content).
